script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Psychological
Theme: ambition

Begin screenplay.

TITLE: THE ECHO CHAMBER

INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY

A sleek, modern apartment. Sunlight filters in through floor-to-ceiling windows, casting a warm glow on the room's minimalist decor.

JAMES (30s, ambitious, handsome) sits on a plush leather couch, intently staring at a laptop on his coffee table. His eyes flicker between the screen and a stack of papers on the table.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
James had always been ambitious. A rising star in the marketing industry, he was determined to climb the corporate ladder and make a name for himself.

INT. OFFICE - DAY

A bustling marketing firm. Colleagues hustle and bustle around desks, phones ringing and computers beeping.

JAMES, seated at his desk, clenches his fists as he listens to his boss, SIMON (40s, intimidating, condescending), berate him for a marketing campaign that didn't perform well.

SIMON
(scoffing)
And this is why we can't trust you with bigger projects, James.

James' face falls as he watches Simon walk away.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
Despite his setbacks, James refused to let his ambition wane. He spent hours upon hours researching and analyzing the latest marketing trends.

INT. LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

James' laptop pings with a new email. He opens it, revealing an invitation to join an exclusive marketing forum.

James' eyes widen as he reads the description:

"The Echo Chamber: A community for the most ambitious and innovative minds in marketing. Join us to share ideas, collaborate on projects, and unlock your full potential."

JAMES
(excitedly)
Yes! This is my chance.

INT. FORUM - DAY

James enters the forum's sleek, modern headquarters. He's greeted by a sea of professionals, all eager to share their knowledge and ideas.

ELIZABETH (30s, confident, charismatic), a fellow marketer, approaches James.

ELIZABETH
(smiling)
Welcome to The Echo Chamber, James. I've heard great things about you.

JAMES
(nervously)
Thank you. I'm excited to be here.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
Over the next few weeks, James throws himself into the forum, attending meetings, participating in discussions, and collaborating on projects. He feels invigorated, like he's finally found his place.

INT. FORUM - NIGHT

James sits at his computer, late into the night, working on a marketing campaign for a client. He's proud of his work and can't wait to present it to the group.

Suddenly, his phone buzzes with a message from Elizabeth.

ELIZABETH
(via text)
James, I need to talk to you. Meet me in the parking lot in 10 minutes.

James' heart races as he quickly finishes up his work and rushes to the parking lot.

ELIZABETH
(serious)
James, we've noticed that you've been taking credit for other people's ideas. We can't have that kind of behavior in The Echo Chamber.

JAMES
(defensive)
What? No, that's not true! I've been working on this campaign completely on my own.

ELIZABETH
(skeptical)
We've seen the emails. You've been copying and pasting ideas from other members and claiming them as your own. That's unacceptable.

JAMES
(realizing)
I...I see. I've been so focused on my ambition that I lost sight of the importance of giving credit where it's due.

ELIZABETH
(nodding)
Good. Learn from this mistake and move forward. But know that we won't tolerate that kind of behavior again.

INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY

James sits at his laptop, reflecting on Elizabeth's words. He realizes that his ambition had blinded him to the importance of collaboration and giving credit where it's due.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
From that day forward, James dedicated himself to working with others and giving credit where it's due. He learned that true success comes not from individual ambition, but from the collective effort of a team.

INT. FORUM - DAY

James presents his latest marketing campaign to the group. He's nervous, but confident, knowing that this time, the ideas are truly his own.

The group applauds and offers praise for his hard work.

ELIZABETH
(smiling)
Great job, James. We're all proud of you.

James smiles back, grateful for the second chance he's been given.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
And so, James continued to grow and learn within The Echo Chamber, surrounded by the support and collaboration of his colleagues. His ambition had not been extinguished, but rather refined, and he knew that he was on the path to true success.

FADE OUT.
